title: The Mother's Monster passes 86 million views, the most-watched AI film of 2026
excerpt: MYTHRA's debut short — about a mother protecting the dragon she gave birth to from her village's superstition — has pulled ahead of every AI series and short released this year, topping AIMB's 2026 views ranking.
body: The Mother's Monster, a standalone fantasy short from the AI studio MYTHRA, has reached roughly 86 million views on the version published through MYTHRA's own YouTube channel — comfortably the highest view count of any AI film or series AIMB has tracked in 2026, ahead of multi-episode shows with far more total runtime to accumulate views across.

The film is MYTHRA's debut feature-length release, described by the studio as an original story written from imagination rather than adapted from any existing book, film or legend. Its 28-minute runtime follows a mother who gives birth to a dragon her village brands a monster, and who has to protect him from the superstition that surrounds them both.

Audience comments on the video lean heavily into pride in the creator's nationality: "Well done to the Pakistani boy who created this AI movie!" (@sabirali5256), "Best Film Ever I Seen and created by Pakistani" (@Aliyaanhere), and "Well Done bro keep it up Proudly Pakistani" (@gmustafa9574) are among the top comments.

As with every figure in AIMB's views coverage, this is a snapshot rather than an audited count — YouTube view totals keep moving, and MYTHRA's film is one of several places the same story may have been republished online. It currently sits at the top of AIMB's ranking of 2026's most-watched AI series and shorts.
